08-epochs.heading: 11.2 What the client does
08-epochs.ascii:
Active(e, H) ── first EpochNotice(e+1, H′, s, seq_index) ──► Scheduled(T)
   prepare: T = now + s (or the schedule), K_seq/K_out(e+1, i) for both sequencer boxes i,
            own lane in lane_map(e+1); if moved: pre-open before the cutoff (§9.1, §9.2)
 Scheduled ── own clock ≥ T, or EpochNotice(0), or Reject EPOCH_MISMATCH from H ──► Switching

   3. then send new packets to H′; each gets a queued Ack within 1 µs of reaching H′ (§7.11)

   4. after U: ResendReq for any resp_seq gap older than EPO_DRAIN_MS, including late

10-accounts-risk-md.heading: 7.4 MBO structure: lane channels, a step channel, and the merge rule
10-accounts-risk-md.ascii:
lane channel k:  ADD ADD SYNC(T) DEL ADD ... │ header.step_base = W_k (watermark)
 step channel:    STEP(T) EXEC EXEC ... STEP(T+3) EXEC ...

 SYNC(T): the lane-op records after it (up to the next SYNC) are ordered after step T and
          before step T+1. Emitted lazily, only before the first record after a new step.
 W_k:     every record of channel k ordered before step W_k + 1 is in this packet or earlier.

 Subscriber rule: apply step T only when W_k ≥ T − 1 for every k. Before step T, apply every
 pending lane-op record whose SYNC position is < T, in any order across channels.
